# Turn a Lemon Squeezy Orders export into a Xero or QuickBooks journal

> Free Lemon Squeezy payout to journal converter: reads the Lemon Squeezy Orders export (amounts in USD cents), splits product sales, discounts, the Lemon Squeezy fee (estimated at the published 5% + 50c plus any surcharge you enter, since the export has no fee column) and refunds by month, books payout fees, leaves out tax Lemon Squeezy remits as merchant of record, checks the result against your bank deposit, and downloads a balanced journal for Xero, QuickBooks Online or QuickBooks Desktop.

Limits: fees are estimates proved only by the deposit check; one surcharge percentage per file; no real export was available when this was written (columns from Lemon Squeezy's exporting-orders help page).

Free to use and source available (FSL-1.1-MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
